title: Parallel track: deployment, design, and environment hardening

comments.author: home
comments.text:
PURPOSE: work that can proceed INDEPENDENTLY of the renderer critical path (PPY-92f846), so a swarm of agents can make progress while the orchestrating session is rate-limited.

RULES FOR ANYONE PICKING UP FROM THIS EPIC:
- Read PPY-92f846's HANDOFF comment first for repo/branch/push state and the decided nomenclature (Renderer x Layout). Do not relitigate settled decisions.
- These tasks are deliberately scoped to NOT collide with the renderer work. Do not refactor lib/renderer.ts or renderers/pretext/ from here; if you must, comment on PPY-92f846 instead of editing.
- Report findings as Kanbus comments as you go, not only at the end. The orchestrator may be throttled; Kanbus is the shared state.
- Do not push and do not open PRs without Ryan's explicit say-so. Everything is local on feature/renderer-architecture (Papyrus) and feature/document-ir (Markus), neither pushed.
- Ryan endorsed working directly in AnthusAI/Papyrus. Not a fork.
- Do not close your own issue; comment your findings and leave it for review.
